title: This gold MacBook Air refurb with Thunderbolt 3 drops to $267.99
content:
Macworld

TL;DR: Get a refurbished 13-inch MacBook Air with a Retina display and 12-hour battery for $267.99 (MSRP $1,399).

A new MacBook is a big expense for a laptop you might only use for browsing, email, and documents. This refurbished 2018 MacBook Air has a 13-inch Retina display and a grade-A rating, and it’s on sale for $267.99. The coolest part? It comes in a unique, sleek gold color.

A 1.6GHz dual-core Intel Core i5 turbo-boosts to 3.6GHz, enough for browsing, document editing, and light photo editing. With 8GB of RAM, you can keep a browser and a few apps open while you work. Storage is a 256GB SSD.

On the 13.3-inch Retina display, a 2560×1600 resolution keeps text and photos sharp. Battery life reaches up to 12 hours, long enough for a full day of browsing or a couple of movies. Touch ID unlocks the Mac with your fingerprint, and two Thunderbolt 3 ports charge the laptop and connect an external display. At 2.75 pounds, this MacBook Air fits easily in a bag.

Its “A” grade means near-mint condition, with very little to no scuffing on the case. This model updates to macOS 14 Sonoma but can’t run macOS 26, so it makes the most sense as an everyday or backup laptop. A wall charger and a 40-day parts and labor warranty are included.

Get a Retina MacBook Air for a fraction of its original price.
